dependency: Optional energy-methods 0.1.1, Python 3.12+; existing requirements/operations.txt pins wheel SHA256. Standard-library method only; install wheel with --no-deps. Core offline screen requires Python 3.11+ and no EDI.
capability: screen_bess_service: constant AC power limit from remaining DC capacity, SOC window and discharge efficiency
adapter: For each plan/year/scenario pass remaining DC MWh after cohort degradation, usable_capacity_fraction=1, explicit initial/reserve SOC and discharge efficiency. Check sustainable AC MW. Never reapply retention or double-count efficiency. Does not validate economics, warranty, recharge, grid-forming, or tender compliance.
execution: Only --edi or the dedicated integration test executes EDI; catalogue inspection is not execution.
licensing: Upstream methods metadata declares LicenseRef-ASVA-Noncommercial-1.0; a commercial offering would require appropriate upstream rights. No upstream source is vendored.

not_reused.reason: Merchant cashflow and captured-margin model uses retention but has no cohort additions, maintained-duration sizing or augmentation costs. No revenue is inferred here.
Climate-driven PV degradation, not a calibrated battery ageing model.
Dispatch simulation is unnecessary for a fully charged single-event capacity envelope; no renewable trace or recharge claim.
